AddressingPolicy.description: Defaults for the first blueprint, supplied explicitly to topology planning.

EndpointAttachment.description: Per-endpoint physical attachment. Missing attachment defaults to 1 Gbps copper.

Ipv4Prefix.description: Canonical IPv4 network CIDR; host bits are rejected, never silently discarded.

TrafficDistribution.description:
Session cohorts are simultaneous upper-bound reservations, not average rates.
Sessions remain indivisible even when a demand may use multiple paths.

WanService.description:
Explicit confirmed attachment to an abstract WAN service. Matching provider
names alone never imply connectivity. Each connected peer must reciprocate.
